scenes.narration: An orchestra conductor reads from sheet music. The players simply follow along. That's how Ansible works.

scenes.heading: The orchestra
scenes.narration: Ansible pushes instructions out to every device. The control node is the conductor. It connects to each device over S S H. The sheet music is a playbook, written in Y A M L. Each task calls a module to do one job.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. It's agentless. Playbooks are written in Y A M L. Modules run on the control node.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Ansible pushes over S S H, with no agent. Playbooks are Y A M L. Modules run on the control node. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva Ansible lab.

points.t: Modules run on the control node
